The '''ANq 2.4 tracking computer''' was a [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computer]] manufactured by [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]].<ref name="TSC">{{StoryCite|story=The Stele Chronicles|book=Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)}}</ref> It was commonly installed on [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]].<ref name="Z95">{{DB|starship|z95headhunter|Z-95 Headhunter}}</ref>
